accounts_onboarding_idx.name: accounts_onboarding_idx
accounts_onboarding_idx.where: "accounts"."onboarded_at" is null and "accounts"."deleting_at" is null and "accounts"."deleted_at" is null

accounts_email_proof.name: accounts_email_proof
accounts_email_proof.value: ("accounts"."email_verified_at" is null and "accounts"."email_proof_method" is null and "accounts"."email_proof_ref" is null) or ("accounts"."email_verified_at" is not null and "accounts"."email_proof_method" is not null and "accounts"."email_proof_method" in ('didit_otp','didit_google','legacy_verified') and "accounts"."email_proof_ref" is not null and char_length(btrim("accounts"."email_proof_ref")) between 1 and 500)

accounts_onboarded_v2.name: accounts_onboarded_v2
accounts_onboarded_v2.value: "accounts"."onboarded_at" is null or ("accounts"."email_verified_at" is not null and "accounts"."profile_completed_at" is not null and "accounts"."email_verified_at"<="accounts"."onboarded_at" and "accounts"."profile_completed_at"<="accounts"."onboarded_at")

calendar_profiles_cover.name: calendar_profiles_cover
calendar_profiles_cover.value: ("calendar_profiles"."cover" is null) = ("calendar_profiles"."cover_type" is null) and ("calendar_profiles"."cover_type" is null or "calendar_profiles"."cover_type" in ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')) and "calendar_profiles"."cover_version" >= 0

calendar_profiles_logo.name: calendar_profiles_logo
calendar_profiles_logo.value: ("calendar_profiles"."logo" is null) = ("calendar_profiles"."logo_type" is null) and ("calendar_profiles"."logo_type" is null or "calendar_profiles"."logo_type" in ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')) and "calendar_profiles"."logo_version" >= 0

calendar_profiles_links.name: calendar_profiles_links
calendar_profiles_links.value: ("calendar_profiles"."website_url" is null or "calendar_profiles"."website_url" like 'https://%') and ("calendar_profiles"."x_url" is null or "calendar_profiles"."x_url" like 'https://%') and ("calendar_profiles"."linkedin_url" is null or "calendar_profiles"."linkedin_url" like 'https://%')

didit_workflows_price.name: didit_workflows_price
didit_workflows_price.value:
("didit_workflows"."min_price_micros" is null and "didit_workflows"."max_price_micros" is null) or
    ("didit_workflows"."min_price_micros" is not null and "didit_workflows"."max_price_micros" is not null and
     "didit_workflows"."min_price_micros">=0 and "didit_workflows"."max_price_micros">0 and "didit_workflows"."min_price_micros"<="didit_workflows"."max_price_micros")

didit_workflows_ready.name: didit_workflows_ready
didit_workflows_ready.value:
"didit_workflows"."state"<>'ready' or
    ("didit_workflows"."workflow_id" is not null and "didit_workflows"."provider_version_id" is not null and
     "didit_workflows"."min_price_micros" is not null and "didit_workflows"."max_price_micros" is not null and "didit_workflows"."verified_at" is not null)

event_assets_dimensions.name: event_assets_dimensions
event_assets_dimensions.value: "event_assets"."width" between 1 and 4096 and "event_assets"."height" between 1 and 4096 and "event_assets"."width"::bigint*"event_assets"."height"::bigint<=12000000

events_place_coords.name: events_place_coords
events_place_coords.value: ("events"."lat" is null) = ("events"."lng" is null) and ("events"."lat" is null or ("events"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "events"."lng" between -180 and 180))

events_requirements_types.name: events_requirements_types
events_requirements_types.value: (not ("events"."requirements" ? 'identity') or jsonb_typeof("events"."requirements"->'identity') = 'boolean') and (not ("events"."requirements" ? 'email') or jsonb_typeof("events"."requirements"->'email') = 'boolean') and (not ("events"."requirements" ? 'liveness') or jsonb_typeof("events"."requirements"->'liveness') = 'boolean') and (not ("events"."requirements" ? 'age_min') or (jsonb_typeof("events"."requirements"->'age_min') = 'number' and ("events"."requirements"->>'age_min')::numeric between 1 and 100 and mod(("events"."requirements"->>'age_min')::numeric,1)=0))

evidence_one_current_face.name: evidence_one_current_face
evidence_one_current_face.where: "evidence"."kind" = 'face' and "evidence"."state" = 'active' and "evidence"."invalidated_at" is null and "evidence"."superseded_at" is null

evidence_binding_v2.name: evidence_binding_v2
evidence_binding_v2.value: ("evidence"."binding"='legacy_chain' and "evidence"."kind" in ('identity','face','age') and "evidence"."subject_face_id" is null) or ("evidence"."binding"='account' and "evidence"."kind"='phone' and "evidence"."subject_face_id" is null and "evidence"."continuity_of" is null) or ("evidence"."binding"='face_chain' and "evidence"."kind" in ('document','age') and "evidence"."subject_face_id" is not null)

evidence_recovery_pair.name: evidence_recovery_pair
evidence_recovery_pair.value: ("evidence"."recovered_by" is null and "evidence"."recovery_reason" is null) or ("evidence"."recovered_by" is not null and "evidence"."recovery_reason" is not null and length(btrim("evidence"."recovered_by")) > 0 and length(btrim("evidence"."recovery_reason")) > 0)

evidence_age_value.name: evidence_age_value
evidence_age_value.value: "evidence"."kind" <> 'age' or ("evidence"."value" is not null and jsonb_typeof("evidence"."value") = 'number')

registration_submissions_payload.name: registration_submissions_payload
registration_submissions_payload.value:
("registration_submissions"."payload_purged_at" is null and
    application_v2_ok("registration_submissions"."application") is true and request_receipt_v1_ok("registration_submissions"."receipt") is true) or
    ("registration_submissions"."payload_purged_at" is not null and "registration_submissions"."application" is null and "registration_submissions"."receipt" is null)

registrations_payload_v2.name: registrations_payload_v2
registrations_payload_v2.value: ("registrations"."application_purged_at" is null and application_v2_ok("registrations"."application_v2") is true and (("registrations"."request_receipt" is null and "registrations"."legacy_imported" and "registrations"."request_completed_at" is null and "registrations"."profile_version_at_request" is null) or (request_receipt_v1_ok("registrations"."request_receipt") is true and "registrations"."request_completed_at" is not null and "registrations"."profile_version_at_request" is not null and "registrations"."profile_version_at_request">0 and ("registrations"."request_receipt"->>'profileVersion')::integer="registrations"."profile_version_at_request" and ("registrations"."request_receipt"->>'evaluatedAt')::timestamptz="registrations"."request_completed_at"))) or ("registrations"."application_purged_at" is not null and "registrations"."application_v2" is null and "registrations"."request_receipt" is null and "registrations"."staff_note" is null)

sessions_principal_binding.name: sessions_principal_binding
sessions_principal_binding.value: ("sessions"."principal" = 'guest' and "sessions"."account_id" is not null and "sessions"."staff_email" is null) or ("sessions"."principal" = 'staff' and "sessions"."staff_email" is not null and "sessions"."account_id" is null and "sessions"."auth_method" in ('oidc_google','email_otp'))

spend_amounts.name: spend_amounts
spend_amounts.value: "spend"."usd_max_micros" > 0 and ("spend"."actual_micros" is null or "spend"."actual_micros" between 0 and "spend"."usd_max_micros")

verification_ops_vendor_v2.name: verification_ops_vendor_v2
verification_ops_vendor_v2.value: char_length("verification_ops"."vendor_data") between 1 and 254 and "verification_ops"."email_at_creation"=lower(btrim("verification_ops"."email_at_creation")) and char_length("verification_ops"."email_at_creation") between 3 and 254

verification_ops_consent_v2.name: verification_ops_consent_v2
verification_ops_consent_v2.value: "verification_ops"."purpose"='legacy' or ("verification_ops"."workflow_key" is not null and consent_receipt_v1_ok("verification_ops"."consent") is true)
